Hypergolic host-supplied adaptation: zod@3.23.8, local revision hypergolic-size-gate-1.
The bundled Zod module includes the oversized constrained-collection early-abort
backport from upstream commit a0ebf970f2d752e5f58527cd2942ff48be4f46bd.
The original signed Recipe Cards HTML is unchanged. See manifest.json and
zod-size-gate.patch for the original release integrity, patch and source hashes.
